description: Run every applicable playbook over a matter in one pass and materialize their columns onto its table: a playbook with no document-type scope always applies, one scoped to a document type only when that type is present among the matter's classified documents. Each playbook pins its own latest approved version and opens its own per-document runs; a playbook that hits a limit is skipped while the rest continue. Returns typed per-playbook refusals (code, status, message, hint, retryable), how many playbooks ran, how many columns were materialized, and how many document runs opened. Use playbooks.run for a single playbook.
